description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohaddaramulla East, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530014
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and registration particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
